description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'BaseCustomizableValidator' that provides utility methods for validating 'Customizable' subclasses within the OpenMRS project. It includes methods to validate attributes based on their types, ensuring compliance with min/max occurrence constraints and attribute value validation.

classes.name: BaseCustomizableValidator
classes.description: An abstract validator class for validating 'Customizable' subclasses, providing methods to ensure attribute occurrence constraints and validate attribute values.

methods.name: validateAttributes
methods.description: Validates the attributes of a 'Customizable' object against a set of attribute types, checking for required min/max occurrences and attribute validity using external validation utilities.
